note: The entry follows Hill's 1915 original description (alate); the original is a library OCR text in which the wing width figures are clearly typographically damaged; they are noted in the text and only the confirmable values are retained.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Upper surface of the head chestnut; mouthparts ochre; antennae dull ochre, the tips of the segments paler; thorax and shoulder plates rusty; abdominal tergites dark brown, each sternite with a pale brown spot at either end; the rest ochre. Length with wings 20 mm, body length 10 mm. Head hairy, rounded behind, widest at the compound eyes, sloping towards the base of the clypeus, the top flat and divided by an indistinct longitudinal suture which, at the level of the middle of the compound eyes, merges into a forked cleft; compound eyes medium-sized, prominent, with fine facets; ocelli oval, close against the inner margin of the compound eyes. Antennae 16-segmented, stout and hairy: segment 1 long and somewhat top-shaped; segment 2 less than half as long as segment 1, slightly swollen at the tip; segment 3 about as long as segment 2, stalked; segment 4 very short and more rounded; segments 5—7 larger and rounded; segments 8—15 elongate, stalked and swollen towards the tip; segment 16 shorter, elongate-oval. Clypeus medium-sized and hairy, slightly arcuate behind, leaf-like in front, pale and bluntly pointed at the tip. Labrum narrow at the base, swollen at the sides, rounded in front, covering the tips of the mandibles. Mandibles large: the tip of the right mandible with 2 sharp stout horn-like teeth, followed by a short blunt tooth and a large serrate basal tooth; the left mandible with 2 sharp apical teeth, the last connected by a long cutting edge to a 3rd, smaller tooth; a large irregular blunt tooth at the base of the mandible opposite the serrate tooth of the right mandible. Pronotum hairy and broad but narrower than the head, the middle of the anterior margin upturned, the sides passing smoothly into the posterior margin (which is nearly straight), with deep impressions on either side of the midline behind the upturned anterior margin. Shoulder plates hairy and small; transverse suture transverse. Wings very large (as printed in the original: fore wing length 27 mm, width 44 mm; hind wing length 164 mm, width 5 mm, evidently typographic or OCR damage, so only the fore wing length of 27 mm is recorded). The lower edge of the base of the costa and the whole length of the subcosta deep yellow, giving the anterior margin of the wing a conspicuous tone.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original was published as Eutermes longipennis, nov. sp., from Northern Territory specimens.
